c0410: 3. On "Break-Even" you only type the seat-turn ceiling your space allows; everything else derives from the rest. The other three tabs also have green cells you can change: the pessimistic and optimistic scenarios on "Scenarios", the seasonality and the launch ramp-up on "12-Month Cash Flow", and the other financing sources on "Financing" (rows 8-11 count as sources but are not amortized: your bank or SBA 7(a) loan goes in "Loan requested" on "0. Assumptions"). Everything else is calculated.
